dep_tag_width.description: Width of the bingo HW manager per-edge dependency tag (DepTagWidth). Bounds the number of concurrently live producers a dependency cell can distinguish; exported to SW as BINGO_DEP_TAG_WIDTH so the task-descriptor packing matches the RTL.

bingo_watchdog_timeout_cycles.description: Bingo HW manager watchdog timeout (WatchdogHeartbeatTimeoutCycles): quad-clock cycles a busy core may run without writing the heartbeat CSR before it is reported dead_suspect.

bingo_watchdog_confirm_timeout_cycles.description: Bingo HW manager confirm timeout (WatchdogConfirmTimeoutCycles): quad-clock cycles without heartbeat after which a busy core is fenced (sticky) and its outstanding tasks are replayed on an allowed live core. Must exceed bingo_watchdog_timeout_cycles; 0 disables fencing and replay (detection only).

bingo_substitute_level_mask.description: Bingo HW manager SubstituteLevelMask: where a fenced core's tasks may go. Bit 0: a core of the same cluster, bit 1: a core of another cluster, bit 2: another chiplet through bingo_hw_manager_remote_link (level 3). Default 1 (level 1 only).

bingo_import_substitute_level_mask.description: Bingo HW manager ImportSubstituteLevelMask: levels (bits 0-1) an imported level-3 task may use to find a live stand-in for its home slot (an imported task is never exported again, so bit 2 is not allowed). Default: bingo_substitute_level_mask & 3. Differing from it is a debug aid (e.g. mask 4 with import mask 1 forces every task of a fenced core through the remote link, and a loopback target runs it on a same-cluster core).

bingo_cluster_bound_core_types.description: Bingo core types whose tasks must stay in their assigned cluster. These types have level-2 substitution disabled and cannot have a level-3 target. Must be explicitly declared when level 2 is enabled.

bingo_remote_target_chip.description: Level-3 remote target per bingo core type: {"<core type id>": <chip id>}. Types not listed are never exported. The own chip id is a loopback (the packets go through the quad AXI-Lite xbar back to this chiplet's remote link mailboxes). Default: none.

bingo_remote_peer_chips.description: Chip ids that may send level-3 packets to this chiplet (dispatches to run or dones of its exports). The targets of bingo_remote_target_chip are always included.

bingo_remote_dispatch_credits.description: Level-3 dispatch credits per peer chiplet (bingo_hw_manager_remote_link DispatchCredits).

use_vendor_pll.description: Whether to use the vendor PLL or bypass it and use the input clock directly
